tender.title: Warden Call Equipment, Smoke Alarms and Automatic Doors - Maintenance, Repairs and Digital Upgrade

classification.description: Repair and maintenance services of security and defence materials

tender.description: Trust wishes to appoint a suitably competent contractor to deliver planned preventative maintenance, reactive repairs and associated replacement works for warden call equipment, grouped and dispersed alarm systems, domestic smoke, heat and carbon monoxide alarms, door entry systems and automatic doors across Trust developments and dwellings. The contract also includes support for system upgrades, maintenance of connected peripherals and attendance to reported faults in accordance with the Specification of Requirements.

This procurement is being conducted in accordance with the Procurement Reform (Scotland) Act 2014, the Public Contracts (Scotland) Regulations 2015, and all relevant statutory guidance and procurement policy applicable to regulated procurements in Scotland.
Full information can be found in the Invitation to Tender, Conditions of Contract and associated appendices

renewal.description: The contract is available for additional extension periods, first of 2-years then each of one year to a total maximum contract term of 10-years (3+2+1+1+1+1+1).
